NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author posted before/after screenshots with the plain-text theme and explained what each one shows. There was no new push, and none was needed, since the only ask was the screenshots.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots cover the Save modal and the buddy list, and say the display of status emoji is unchanged. |
| ⚠️  | The PR description still says the bug wasn't reproduced by hand, and the manual-testing checkboxes are unticked. The screenshots now show the bug and the fix, so the description is stale. |
| ℹ️  | The open #37967 by a collaborator fixes the same issue (#34985) and has been waiting for review since February. A reviewer should decide which one to take. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — gave the feedback and already knows what the screenshots need to show.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review" and assign laurynmm, who can also decide between this PR and #37967.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! @laurynmm, could you review this?
```
